sources.snippet: Cogni-OpenModel: Safety‑aware, non‑clinical conversational AI for supportive mental health and wellbeing use‑cases, built on Meta Llama 3.1 8B and fine‑tuned with LoRA. This repository contains the model configuration, tokenizer, generation defaults, and adapter metadata for efficient deployment.
